post_campaign_documentation.change: Updated only the public render_drawing_group docstring to list rectangle gradients

late_kill_witnesses: Exact lowest nonzero alpha and zero-opacity short circuit
All-corner rounded clipping and explicit sharp/rounded dispatch
Two-dimensional tile size and destination bounds
Single-pixel intersections and subpixel valid axes
Live malformed, overflow, and zero-length axis failures

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: logical radius greater-than zero changed to not-equal zero
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: normalize_rectangle_corner_radii proves rx and ry are nonnegative. On that domain, r > 0.0 if and only if r != 0.0.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: pixel radius equality with zero changed to less-than-or-equal zero
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: Each pixel radius is either literal zero or min(nonnegative half-size, max(1, rounded positive radius)); it can never be negative. Therefore radius == 0 and radius <= 0 are identical.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: squared axis length less-than-or-equal zero changed to equality
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: The value is delta_x squared plus delta_y squared and is finite at this guard, so it is nonnegative. Thus <= 0.0 and == 0.0 are identical.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: alpha equality with zero changed to less-than-or-equal zero
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: DrawingStyle proves fill_opacity is in [0, 1], and round(opacity * 255) is an integer in [0, 255]. On that domain, alpha == 0 and alpha <= 0 are identical.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: explicit NumPy clip endpoint changed from zero to minus one or from one to two
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: numpy.interp independently extends the first and last stop colors for every query outside the stop-offset domain [0, 1]. Expanding the preceding clip interval therefore produces the same channel bytes for every finite position.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: new L mask background zero changed to minus one
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: Pillow mode L normalizes both Image.new fill values 0 and -1 to byte zero. The masks are byte-identical before drawing.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: rounded-mask stroke width zero changed to minus one or one
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: The same call passes stroke=None. _draw_rounded_rectangle enters its stroke block only when stroke is not None, so stroke_width is never read for these calls.
